data: Did the peak of the density function shift towards lower standard deviations after 100 iterations of extended Baum-Welch?

The blue line represents the densities of the scaled standard deviations before 100 iterations of extended Baum-Welch, while the black line represents the densities after 100 iterations. The peak of the blue line is at approximately 1.0 on the x-axis, while the peak of the black line is slightly to the left of the blue line's peak, closer to 0.8. This indicates that the peak shifted towards lower standard deviations after 100 iterations of extended Baum-Welch.
Yes, the peak of the density function shifted towards lower standard deviations after 100 iterations of extended Baum-Welch.
